scene_purpose: Let Torren fully perform the guide role he has accepted; make southern Briar Passage a substantial playable route area; establish the overgrown old stone-lined side access that only becomes meaningful after the Junction map reveal; build the Briarhide Stalker as a naturally occurring powerful predator through light field evidence and a later clear sighting; and bring the party to the last stretch before the Junction without revealing or visually exposing the hidden monument early.

scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Torren is genuinely leading, so limited walking dialogue is legal only when it materially belongs to immediate route guidance. Most traversal remains gameplay and silence. Ordinary enemies remain random encounters. REHEARSAL-FIRST: keep character speech natural and selective; do not verbalize knowledge limits as a ritual. REDUCTIVE HD-2D: do not invent extra set pieces, lookout platforms, feeding-site scenes, distant monument silhouettes, crowds, bespoke props, or additional clues. HARD JUNCTION CORRECTION: Torren knows the Junction as an ancient crossroads used by modern routes. The hidden monument shown in the Hollow Watch mural is NOT visible from a distance and Torren has never seen its exposed stone/map surface. Present-day vines and moss conceal it until the later Junction reveal. Do not use Wayfinder as the characters' current name for the place. The overgrown side access remains unexplained here. The Briarhide is natural wildlife. Cyanis carries the intact Card itself; it remains inert.

current_floor_state.junction_knowledge: Torren knows the ancient crossroads and route only; hidden monument remains unseen

required_story_beats: Torren actively leads the group through southern Briar using practical local expertise.
The area receives substantial uninterrupted exploration with ordinary combat presented as random encounters.
The party passes one heavily overgrown old stone-lined side access; it is noted and left unexplored.
A small amount of natural field evidence establishes that a very large Briarhide is active nearby.
The route visibly approaches the Junction through road convergence / terrain, not by revealing the hidden monument.
The party receives one clear Briarhide Stalker sighting before the final boss encounter.
Beat ends with the Stalker as the immediate natural threat on the last stretch before the Junction.
